values.note: Village of Hillman's rate table: RV sites with 30-amp and water $25 a night, full-hookup (30/50-amp, water, sewer) $30; monthly $500/$550, selected seasonal sites $3,000 (May 1 - Oct 31); family site #10 (up to 3 RVs) $75; tent sites $15. Read 2026-10-25 (page (c) 2026).

fees.source: https://emerickpark.com/ (Rates & Sites: 'Nightly: $30' for sites 1, 11-17, 21-26 with 30A/50A, water, sewer; 'Nightly: $25' for sites 2, 5-8, 18-20 with 30A, water), read 2026-10-25

values.note: 14 full-hookup sites (pull-thru, 21-26 back-in), 8 water/electric back-ins, family site #10 (back-in, max 38 ft, up to 3 RVs) and 3 tent sites.

sites.source: https://emerickpark.com/ ('features 26 sites'; Rates & Sites: 'Access: pull-thru, back-in (21-26)'), read 2026-10-25

season.source: https://emerickpark.com/ (Dates & Hours: 'Season: May 1 - Oct 31', 'Off-Season: Nov 1 - 30'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Book online through the village's Let's Camp page ('Reserve Now!', emerickpark.campgroundonline.org redirects there). Check-in 2 pm, check-out 11 am.

booking.source: https://emerickpark.com/ ('Reserve your site now by clicking the Reserve Now button above or visiting https://emerickpark.campgroundonline.org/') + Let's Camp camp data (status live, check-in 14:00, check-out 11:00), read 2026-10-25

note: Village of Hillman park on the Thunder Bay River, 20 acres; gravel pads, kayak/canoe launch, bandshell with free Saturday-night bands in summer. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the village's own site: $25 (30A/water) to $30 (full hookup) nightly, 30/50-amp with water and sewer, 26 sites with pull-throughs, showers/dump/WiFi, reservable online (Let's Camp). Season set to May 1 - Oct 31 (off-season Nov). Fixed the fees note's 'Village of Hale'. Mostly nightly: only 'selected' sites are sold seasonally ($3,000) and monthly rates are posted beside the nightly ones; the share of seasonal sites isn't stated. Note trimmed of what the fields now hold and the RV Life line.
